description: Fetch a URL and fingerprint its likely tech stack from response headers (server, x-powered-by, x-generator) and HTML markers (generator meta tag, framework/CMS-specific script or class patterns). Answers 'what is this site built with?' — for on-page SEO/content signals use seo_audit, for raw structured data use structured_data_extract. Best-effort — not exhaustive, no additional paths are probed.
name: tech_stack_fingerprint
